facts.intro: You see a sturdy wooden handle attached to a small gear.
facts.reveal: The small gear meshes with a much larger gear that holds the lower millstone.
facts.step1: Turning the handle rotates the small gear clockwise.
facts.step2: The small gear pushes the teeth of the large gear, making it turn slower but with more torque.
facts.step3: The large gear spins the lower millstone while the upper stone stays fixed.
facts.step4: Grains placed between the stones are crushed as the lower stone rotates.
facts.hold: The handle stays in your hand, letting you control the grinding speed.
facts.payoff: The crushed flour falls out the side, showing the mechanism’s purpose.
